thesis.current: CivicState may become a paid civic letter workflow if users pay for researched, citation-backed official outreach and delivery risk stays manageable.
thesis.evidenceState: Implementation exists; demand and production economics are not evidenced.

customer.primary: US resident with a specific civic issue who wants a researched letter to relevant officials.
excluded: Users needing a social network or organizing platform at launch

market.sizingMethod: Bottom-up validation model because workspace has no external market research.
market.launchWedge: 500 visitors/month x 3% conversion x $15 blended package = $225/month [assumption: BUSINESS.md validation model]
market.treatment: Unproven until conversion, deliverability, official response, and refund metrics exist.

streams: Future API or organizational access only after consumer workflow validation [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md out-of-scope]
businessModel.status: No workspace evidence of paid revenue.

financialModel.summary: Year A revenue $13,500 [assumption: BUSINESS.md]; Year B revenue $57,600 [assumption: BUSINESS.md]; Year C revenue $216,000 [assumption: BUSINESS.md].
revenueAssumptions: Conversion target begins at 3% [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md validation gate]
costAssumptions: Direct cost starts at 25% of revenue until measured [assumption: BUSINESS.md]
sensitivityTests: Conversion at 1% cuts the 500-visitor launch model from $225/month to $75/month [assumption: BUSINESS.md]
Blended price at $5 cuts Year B revenue from $57,600 to $18,000 [assumption: BUSINESS.md]
Human review at 20 minutes/package makes Year C ops-limited [assumption: BUSINESS.md]

alternatives: Keep as personal/research civic AI asset if paid conversion fails.
Reposition as internal wrk.vc compliance/research demo if deliverability or legal risk blocks consumer launch.
Sell or partner the workflow to civic organizations only after the individual path proves safe.

holes: Users may not pay because free outreach and advocacy channels are good enough.
Legal, moderation, harassment, or defamation risk may exceed revenue.
Government-domain deliverability may fail, making the paid promise unreliable.
The claimed data moat does not exist at low volume.
mitigations: Closed beta with explicit paid conversion gate.
Mandatory moderation, AI disclosure, not-legal-advice language, and citation verification.
SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain warming, bounce thresholds, opt-out suppression, and spam complaint handling.
Do not claim moat until official directory quality, citation reuse, and public archive data accumulate.
residualRisks: Operator may still need legal review for edge cases.
Local official data quality may remain weak.
Political or sensitive content can create reputational risk even when lawful.

strategy.nearTerm: Reconcile implementation, run controlled paid-flow tests, and collect safety/deliverability metrics.
doNotDo: Do not scale sends before deliverability evidence.
Do not present as legal advice.
Do not pitch as approved BOS-grade investible business.

goToMarket.firstCustomers: Direct beta and narrow SEO tests, not paid ads or partnerships.
goToMarket.firstCustomerPlan: 25 direct beta packages, 50 SEO/direct-intent packages, 25 repeatability packages [assumption: BUSINESS.md]

operatorWorkflow.humanRole: Review flagged submissions, monitor treasury exceptions, resolve deliverability failures, and validate official directory issues.
operatorWorkflow.automation: BullMQ agents handle classification, research, drafting, delivery, treasury, and reconciliation where configured.
operatorWorkflow.constraints: No 24/7 staffing is evidenced [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md lean-operator assumption]; escalation thresholds must protect the operator.

constraints: Registry says watchlist and personal/research asset.
Commercial civic communications require caution around opt-outs, disclaimers, moderation, and sensitive data.
Repo identity mismatch: dispatch says brooks-history, repo content says CivicState.

rules: AI output is never treated as evidence.
External market claims stay assumptions in workspace-only mode.
Citation verification and stripped unverified citations are required before delivery.
AI disclosure must appear in letters.

unknowns: Actual production readiness of every API route and worker.
Live Stripe/Postmark/Clerk configuration and domain status.
Whether operator wants to pitch as business or keep as research asset.
